We’ve been using Multi Location Inventory by Kark and it has made a significant difference in how we manage our inventory on Shopify.

Our setup is quite complex. We deal with thousands of SKUs, multiple locations, different units of measurement, and a heavy use of product tags to control logic and variations. On top of that, we needed to display location-based availability along with minimum quantity warnings at the SKU level, which is much harder to implement than it sounds.

Before using this app, managing all of this was extremely challenging. We tried different approaches and workarounds, but nothing was scalable or efficient.

What really stands out is how this app simplifies a complicated inventory structure. We were able to manage inventory across multiple locations without disrupting our existing setup, handle multiple SKUs and UOM variations smoothly, show accurate location-based availability messaging, and implement minimum quantity warnings without complex custom development.

The biggest highlight, however, is their support.

Their team clearly understands real-world inventory challenges. Every time we had a specific requirement or edge case, they didn’t respond with generic answers. They actually worked through the logic with us and helped implement practical solutions. That level of support is rare.

If you’re running a Shopify store with multi-location inventory and complex SKU structures, this app is incredibly valuable.
